title: 第二章 废土第一课：活着比什么都重要-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、巢穴深处

    那只辐射蟑螂的尸体还横在站台边缘，六足朝天，腹部甲壳在昏暗中泛着油腻冷光。

    林霜垂眸扫了两秒，抬脚径直跨过。

    不是冷漠。

    是脱水早榨干了多余情绪。眼泪需要水分，她现在连唾液都发黏，连咽一口都剌嗓子。

    视野右上角，系统数字静静亮着：2.7μSv/h。

    从醒来至今，她在黄区已经滞留近两小时。碘片只能挡住甲状腺吸收放射性碘，全身细胞的辐射损伤还在一点点累加。

    必须尽快离开地铁站，但走之前，能多拿一点资源，就多一分活下去的可能。

    “系统，扫描巢穴内部，标物资、标威胁。”

    “基础扫描免费，深度扫描消耗 10 能量，当前 90/100，确认执行？”

    “执行。”

    面板刷新。

    巢穴纵深约八米，最深处四平方米。

    可识别：金属容器 1、塑料袋包裹物 3、腐烂有机物若干。

    无活体热源，但检测到12 个低温信号 —— 卵鞘，温度 15℃，预计 72 小时内孵化。

    “卵鞘无直接威胁，但孵化后的若虫会主动追击热源。建议只取便携物资，不要深挖、不要破坏卵鞘 —— 若虫会锁定破坏者气味，追踪 48 小时。”

    林霜从背包侧兜抽出那根六十厘米钢管，一端带螺纹。她横握在身前，侧身钻进分支通道。

    通道比主隧道更矮，她必须微微弯腰。头顶管线挂着蛛网似的灰絮，一碰就簌簌往下掉。空气里呛着氨水与腐肉混合的恶臭，胃猛地抽搐，酸水涌到喉咙，又被她硬咽回去。

    不是坚强，是胃早就空了，吐无可吐。

    巢穴尽头是用废弃座椅、广告牌碎片、干枯植物堆成的窝，中心凹陷处留着半透明黏液，酸臭刺鼻。周围散落着硬币、碎玻璃、铝箔 —— 辐射蟑螂收集反光物的本能。

    林霜没碰那个窝，目光直接扫向散落包裹。

    第一个塑料袋：发霉面包，灰绿菌丝像一层绒毛，直接丢掉。

    第二个：三块肥皂，保鲜膜裹着，干裂但完整。

    她指尖微顿。

    肥皂在废土不是干净，是清创底线。她塞进背包内层。

    第三个：一盒未拆封火柴，五十根，蜡封完好。

    最后是那个军绿色铝制水壶，坑洼斑驳，壶盖拧得死紧。

    拧开，系统即时判定：

    “水质：轻度污染，含微量辐射尘与细菌。短期饮用无急性风险，长期必须煮沸。”

    约五百毫升。

    这是她眼下最值钱的收获。

    水比食物要命 —— 没食物能撑三周，没水三天就休克。

    她把水壶挂在背包侧兜，又扫了一眼最深处的卵鞘，像一串灰白葡萄，每颗拇指大小。

    退两步，确认无遗漏，转身撤离。

    刚回到主隧道，系统警告骤然刺进脑海：

    “多个热源快速接近，距离 60 米，速度中等，数量 6—— 辐射蟑螂返回巢穴并召集同伴。立即撤离。”

    60 米。

    以蟑螂爬行速度，90 秒就到。

    林霜没有跑。

    不能跑。

    奔跑会放大震动与声响，隧道地面覆着蟑螂黏液与腐殖泥，湿滑黏脚，一旦滑倒，就是死局。

    她快步走，每一步踩稳承重处，呼吸保持平稳。左手按住背包，防止杂物晃出声响；右手握死石斧，拇指顶在斧柄与刃口连接处，随时能反手劈击。

    40 米 —— 她走到站台边缘。

    30 米 —— 踏上台阶。

    20 米 —— 推开锈蚀铁门，侧身挤出去。

    10 米 —— 她背靠墙壁，大口喘着地面的浑浊空气。

    刺鼻、呛人、满是臭氧与硫化物的酸味。

    但比隧道里的恶臭，好一万倍。

    六只辐射蟑螂出现在隧道拐角，触须疯狂摆动。它们嗅到入侵者的气味，却猎物已经离开领地范围，只能在洞口焦躁打转。

    林霜等了一分钟，确认没有蟑螂追出，紧绷的肌肉才缓缓松懈。

    左臂在抖 —— 不是怕，是肾上腺素退潮后的虚脱。伤口渗血浸透布条，暗红一片，每一次心跳都带着钝痛。

    但她清楚。

    疼，说明神经还活着。

    比无知觉强太多。

    她抬眼望向四周。

    半塌的街道，左侧是只剩框架的六层楼，钢筋像折断的肋骨刺向天空；右侧路口被水泥块堵死；正前方是建筑垃圾堆成的土路，蜿蜒向北。

    远处天际，灰黄天空与黑灰废墟融成一片，分不出边界。

    没有活人痕迹。

    没有声音。

    连风都像被辐射尘吸走，只剩沉闷、低压的白噪音，像一台坏掉的空调在远处空转。

    这个世界，在替死者沉默。

    二、超市废墟

    系统环境面板刷新：

    【环境信息】

    位置：未知城市废墟

    辐射：2.7μSv/h（黄区）

    温度：9℃

    空气质量：差（辐射尘 + 悬浮颗粒）

    可见度：300 米

    【主线任务】

    安全度过 7 天

    奖励：净水器图纸

    进度：0/7

    剩余：6 天 23 小时 47 分

1. Deep in the lair

The body of the radioactive cockroach was still lying on the edge of the platform, with its six legs in the air, and the carapace on its abdomen glowed with a greasy cold light in the dim light.

Lin Shuang lowered his eyes and glanced for two seconds, then raised his feet and stepped straight across.

It’s not indifference.

It’s dehydration that has drained away excess emotions.Tears needed moisture. Even her saliva was sticky now, and her throat hurt even if she swallowed.

In the upper right corner of the field of view, the system number lights up quietly: 2.7μSv/h.

Since she woke up, she has been stuck in the yellow zone for nearly two hours.Iodine tablets can only block the thyroid gland from absorbing radioactive iodine, and the radiation damage to cells throughout the body is still accumulating little by little.

You must leave the subway station as soon as possible, but before you leave, if you can get more resources, you will have more possibilities to survive.

"System, scan the inside of the nest, flag materials and threats."

"Basic scan is free, deep scan consumes 10 energy, current 90/100, confirm execution?"

"Execution."

The panel refreshes.

The depth of the nest is about eight meters, and the deepest point is four square meters.

Recognizable: Metal container 1, plastic bag wrapping 3, some rotten organic matter.

There is no living heat source, but 12 low-temperature signals were detected - egg sheaths, with a temperature of 15°C and expected to hatch within 72 hours.

"There is no direct threat to the ootheca, but the nymphs after hatching will actively pursue the heat source. It is recommended to only take portable supplies, do not dig deeply, and do not destroy the ootheca - the nymphs will lock on to the scent of the destroyer and track them for 48 hours."

Lin Shuang took out the sixty-centimeter steel pipe with a thread on one end from the side pocket of his backpack.She held it horizontally in front of her and ducked sideways into the branch passage.

The passage was shorter than the main tunnel and she had to bend slightly.The pipes overhead were hung with spiderweb-like gray wadding, which rustled down when touched.The air was filled with the stench of ammonia mixed with rotten meat. Her stomach twitched violently, and acid water surged into her throat, which she swallowed hard.

It’s not that I’m strong, it’s that my stomach has long been empty and I can’t vomit.

At the end of the nest is a nest made of abandoned seats, billboard fragments, and dry plants. There is translucent mucus in the center depression, with a sour and pungent smell.Coins, broken glass, and aluminum foil are scattered around - radiating cockroaches' instinct to collect reflective objects.

Lin Shuang didn't touch the nest, and glanced directly at the scattered packages.

The first plastic bag: moldy bread, gray-green mycelium like a layer of fluff, throw it away directly.

The second one: three pieces of soap, wrapped in plastic wrap, dry and cracked but intact.

Her fingertips paused slightly.

Soap in wasteland does not clean, it cleanses the bottom line.She stuffed it into the inside of her backpack.

The third one: a box of unopened matches, fifty pieces, with the wax seal intact.

Finally, there is the military green aluminum kettle, which is pitted and mottled, and the lid is screwed tightly.

Unscrew it and the system will instantly determine:

"Water quality: lightly polluted, containing trace amounts of radioactive dust and bacteria. There is no acute risk for short-term drinking, but it must be boiled for a long time."

About 500 ml.

This is her most valuable harvest right now.

Water is more deadly than food - you can survive three weeks without food, and you will go into shock after three days without water.

She hung the water bottle in the side pocket of her backpack and glanced at the deepest egg sheaths, which looked like a bunch of gray-white grapes, each about the size of a thumb.

​​Take two steps back, confirm that nothing is missing, turn around and evacuate.

As soon as I returned to the main tunnel, the system warning suddenly pierced my mind:

“Multiple heat sources are approaching quickly, distance is 60 meters, speed is medium, number is 6 - radiated cockroaches return to the nest and gather their companions. Evacuate immediately.”

60 meters.

At the crawling speed of a cockroach, it will be there in 90 seconds.

Lin Shuang didn’t run away.

Can’t run.

Running will amplify the vibrations and sounds. The tunnel floor is covered with cockroach slime and humus mud, making it slippery and sticky to the feet. Once you slip, you are doomed.

She walked quickly, stepping firmly on the weight-bearing part with each step and keeping her breathing steady.Hold down the backpack with your left hand to prevent debris from shaking; hold the dead stone ax in your right hand, with your thumb on the connection between the ax handle and the blade, so you can strike with your backhand at any time.

40 meters - She walked to the edge of the platform.

30 meters - step onto the steps.

20 meters —— Push open the rusted iron door and squeeze out sideways.

10 meters - She leaned against the wall, breathing in the turbid air from the ground.

Pungent, choking, sour smell full of ozone and sulfides.

But it’s ten thousand times better than the stench in the tunnel.

Six radioactive cockroaches appeared at the corner of the tunnel, their tentacles swinging wildly.They smell the scent of intruders, but the prey has left the territory and can only circle anxiously at the entrance of the cave.

Lin Shuang waited for a minute to confirm that no cockroaches were chasing him, and then his tense muscles slowly relaxed.

My left arm was shaking - not from fear, but from exhaustion after the adrenaline ebbs.The wound oozed blood and soaked into the cloth, turning it dark red, and every heartbeat brought a dull pain.

But she knows.

Pain means the nerve is still alive.

It is much better than being unconscious.

She raised her eyes and looked around.

On the half-collapsed street, on the left is a six-story building with only its frame remaining, with steel bars piercing the sky like broken ribs; on the right, the intersection is blocked by cement blocks; directly in front is a dirt road made of construction waste, winding to the north.

In the distant sky, the gray-yellow sky and the black-gray ruins merge into one, indistinguishable boundaries.

There are no traces of anyone alive.

There is no sound.

Even the wind seems to have been sucked away by radiation dust, leaving only dull, low-pressure white noise, like a broken air conditioner idling in the distance.

This world is silent for the dead.

2. Supermarket ruins

System environment panel refresh:

Location: Unknown city ruins

Radiation: 2.7μSv/h (yellow zone)

Temperature: 9℃

Air quality: poor (radiated dust + suspended particles)

Visibility: 300 meters

【Main mission】

Spend 7 days safely

Reward: Water purifier blueprint

Progress: 0/7
